en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਬਨਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau pasaau kar oa(n)kaar akaar banaiaa|

en.bdb: Diffusing His one vibration (vak, sound), Oaiikar has become manifest in the forms (of the whole creation).

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿ ਕੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਥੰਮਾ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)bar dharat vichhoR kai vin tha(n)maa aakaas rahaiaa|

en.bdb: Separating earth from sky, the Oankar has sustained sky without the support of any pillar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jal vich dharatee rakheean dharatee a(n)dhar neer dharaiaa|

en.bdb: He placed earth in water and water in the earth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਠੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗੁ ਧਰਿ ਅਗੀ ਹੋਂਦੀ ਸੁਫਲੁ ਫਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kaaThai a(n)dhar ag dhar agee ho(n)dhee sufal falaiaa|

en.bdb: Fire was put into wood and fire notwithstanding, the trees laden with beautiful fruits were created.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਤਿੰਨੇ ਵੈਰੀ ਮੇਲੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paun paanee baisa(n)taro ti(n)ne vairee mel milaiaa|

en.bdb: Air, water and fire are enemies of one another but He made them meet harmoniously (and created the world).

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਸ ਸਾਤਕ ਤਾਮਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: raajas saatak taamaso brahamaa bisan mahes upaiaa|

en.bdb: He created Brahma, Visnu and Mahes'a who cherish the qualities of action (rajas), sustenance (sattv) and dissolution (tamas).
Accomplisher of wondrous feats, that Lord created the wonderful creation.
